# Hadees Trading (Pty) Ltd

> Enterprise digital infrastructure for South African business — websites, CIPC & tender compliance, CRM, client portal and enterprise AI automation, delivered from Mahikeng.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Hadees Trading's services and platform.
- [About](/about): Company story, mission, values and timeline.
- [Services](/services): Fourteen enterprise services under one roof.
- [Website Packages](/packages): Fixed-price website packages in ZAR.
- [Business Registration](/business-registration): CIPC, COIDA, NHBRC, CIDB, CSD, tax and B-BBEE registration pricing.
- [Compliance](/compliance): Ongoing CIPC, SARS, COIDA, CIDB, B-BBEE, NHBRC and POPIA compliance.
- [Tenders](/tenders): Tender matching, documentation and post-award compliance.
- [IVAN OS](/ivan-os): 27 AI agents, decision console and knowledge graph.
- [Enterprise AI](/enterprise-ai): Document, tender, proposal, invoice and compliance AI.
- [CRM](/crm): Leads, clients, projects, quotes, invoices and pipeline.
- [Client Portal](/client-portal): Secure client-facing portal for invoices, projects and documents.
- [Mobile App](/mobile-app): IVAN Mobile for Android and iOS.
- [Industries](/industries): Sectors we serve across South Africa.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Mahikeng office.
